steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each rating is matched to its evidence and to the success profile. A rating that uses a protected characteristic is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Rating uses a protected characteristic
findings.fix: Remove it and re-rate on the profile

findings.title: Rating with no evidence
findings.fix: Attach the evidence from the profile

findings.title: Measure not in the success profile
findings.fix: Use a measure from the profile

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] cand-04.md:12  Rating uses a protected characteristic.
       Fix: Remove it and re-rate on the profile.
[medium] cand-02.md:19  Rating with no evidence.
       Fix: Attach the evidence from the profile.
[low] success-profile.md:26  Measure not in the success profile.
       Fix: Use a measure from the profile.
Not checked: The candidate's private circumstances.
pros: Checks a rating with no evidence, a rating that uses a protected characteristic, and a measure that is not in the success profile.
cons: Not checked: The candidate's private circumstances.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-longlist-assessment skill on the records for this review.
